data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jabar' which means noble, strong, or exalted. In Islamic tradition, Jabraa is a name of respect and honor for a noble and virtuous boy. The name Jabraa carries the meaning “The Noble One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabraa usually hope their child will grow to embody the noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, nobility, and virtue in Islam.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabraa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
